summary: Mistral released Shieldstral, a 3B-parameter open-weights multimodal safety classifier under Apache 2.0 that evaluates content moderation policies specified in natural language at inference time.

practices.reason: Shieldstral is a downloadable, benchmarked safety classifier that a team could run directly to score content moderation quality against stated axes.
practices.quote: We evaluate Shieldstral against open guard models up to 7x its size across four axes. All evaluation samples are held out from training.

practices.reason: The policy-as-inference-time-question design lets a single checkpoint be re-targeted to new moderation policies without retraining, a concrete pattern a team could build a guardrail layer around.
practices.quote: Shieldstral takes a different approach: you write the policy as a plain-language question at inference time, and the model returns a calibrated safety score. No retraining, one interface for text and images, and a verdict from a single token.
